dispositions.topic_text: Required result when post-open metadata reading fails
Whether non-regular-file or open failure checks terminate processing before the mandatory read
Observable proof that a new placement never reads a conflict copy
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-19 observes the reads and fails when a new placement reads a conflict copy (as round-29 T4, round-30 T3).

dispositions.topic_text: Scope and observable proof that delivery opens no path failing validation
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-02 observes the opening calls and fails when a path that fails condition 1 of A3 rule 5 is opened (as round-29 T3, round-30 T1).

dispositions.topic_text: Whether INV-01 tests must detect transient source-folder mutations during execution
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-01 observes changes to the source tree during each operation, transient ones included (as round-29 T9, round-30 T7).

dispositions.topic_text: Whether INV-07 replacement tests must verify the earlier placement record remains unchanged
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-07 checks the earlier placement record, stored image and mark one by one after a replacement (as round-30 T6).

dispositions.topic_text: Whether INV-12 tests must directly inspect exact durable record, image, and mark counts
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-12 inspects the exact counts of records, stored images and marks it states.
